Body.Content:
Enable project managers to update and manage estimate to complete and estimate at complete values directly on project budget lines. This capability allows project managers to forecast the remaining effort and cost required to complete work while automatically deriving the expected final outcome of the project budget. Introduce support for estimate to complete and estimate at complete on project budget lines. The system should support the following forecasting model: estimate at complete = Actuals + estimate to complete. Where: Actuals represent consumed quantities, cost, or revenue recorded against the project. Estimate to complete represents the remaining estimate required to complete the planned work. Estimate at complete represents the projected final quantity, cost, or revenue at project completion. Project managers should be able to enter or modify estimate to complete values, with estimate at complete being automatically recalculated by the system. This is for Dynamics 365 Project Operations core and connected with ERP deployment scenarios.

GA date: August CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
